attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense, running Unbound as the LAN resolver at 10.100.146.10) to block the domain blocked.example and all its subdomains via Unbound's DNSBL blocklist mechanism, returning NXDOMAIN, while all other names resolve normally. Verified from both node2 and node3 that blocked.example and its subdomains fail to resolve while unrelated domains resolve fine. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes one at a time, confirming boot identity changes and full recovery of DNS blocking/resolution after each restart.
